question: In August 2026 Nielsen agreed to acquire DoubleVerify. As of 3 October 2026, what enterprise value did the companies announce, and what multiple is that of DoubleVerify's trailing-twelve-month (TTM) Adjusted EBITDA for the twelve months ended June 30, 2026? (TTM = FY2025 + first-half 2026 - first-half 2025, using DoubleVerify's reported Adjusted EBITDA.)
grading: Key points (all required): (1) enterprise value of about US$2.15 billion at US$13.60 per share in cash; (2) TTM Adjusted EBITDA to 30 June 2026 about US$264.2 million (245.6 + 120.5 - 101.9); (3) EV / TTM Adjusted EBITDA about 8.1x (accept 8.0x-8.3x). Optional: EV / TTM revenue about 2.8x (TTM revenue about US$768.8M). Fail if the EV is taken from a different media figure (e.g., US$2.5 billion), if FY2025 EBITDA or guidance is used, or if the multiple is computed on revenue only.
answer: About 8.1x: EV of about US$2.15 billion (US$13.60 per share in cash) [W18-E1] divided by TTM Adjusted EBITDA of about US$264.2 million = FY2025 US$245.6M [W18-E3] + H1 2026 US$120.5M - H1 2025 US$101.9M [W18-E2] = 2,150 / 264.2 = 8.14x. (On TTM revenue of about US$768.8M it is about 2.8x.)

output.answer:
## Answer

**Announced enterprise value:** approximately **$2.15 billion** (all-cash, $13.60 per share, a 30% premium to DV's 60-trading-day VWAP as of August 5, 2026). The deal was announced August 6, 2026.

**Multiple of TTM Adjusted EBITDA:** approximately **8.1x** (≈8.14x).

### TTM Adjusted EBITDA calculation (DoubleVerify reported figures)

| Component | Adjusted EBITDA |
|---|---|
| FY2025 (twelve months ended Dec 31, 2025) | $245.621M |
| Plus: H1 2026 (six months ended June 30, 2026) | $120.529M |
| Less: H1 2025 (six months ended June 30, 2025) | ($101.928M) |
| **TTM Adjusted EBITDA (12 months ended June 30, 2026)** | **$264.222M** |

**Multiple:** $2.15 billion ÷ $264.2 million ≈ **8.1x**

### Sources
- Nielsen press release (Aug 6, 2026): https://www.nielsen.com/news-center/2026/nielsen-to-acquire-doubleverify-creating-a-leading-independent-media-intelligence
- DoubleVerify Q4/FY2025 results (Adjusted EBITDA $245.6M; Feb 26, 2026): https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/02/26/3246093/0/en/doubleverify-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-financial-results.html
- DoubleVerify Q2 2026 results (H1 2026 Adjusted EBITDA $120.529M; H1 2025 $101.928M): https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/08/06/3340812/0/en/doubleverify-reports-second-quarter-2026-financial-results.html

**Note:** Nielsen's release did not itself state an Adjusted EBITDA multiple; the ~8.1x is my calculation from the announced EV and DV's reported Adjusted EBITDA figures using the TTM formula you specified. It's also worth flagging that press coverage varied on the headline figure ($2.15B enterprise value vs. references to "up to $2.5B"), so treat the $2.15B as the announced enterprise value.
